name: trial-e7
description: Add-on calibration for E7 (run once per machine, after the machine's first trial and before its first E7 main run): a probe pass of every E7 arm of all 30 algorithms (first call + 5 calls per arm, unbatched). It derives only the batch sizes of the E7 arms, with the first trial's rule; each E7 block takes its operation's (verify or decaps) classification from the first trial. Every other threshold of the machine stays unchanged. Canary every 5 minutes.
